style.vernacular: Capital of Ebonyi State (created 1996) in a forest-savanna belt at the junction of the Enugu, Afikpo and Ogoja roads. Mostly 1-2 storey painted-render and block houses, shops and lock-ups with rust-red or grey corrugated roofs; newer public buildings and bank branches are 2-5 storey rendered blocks; the state is known for concrete roads and big rice and yam markets, and flyovers and malls are recent additions.
style.ornament: Plain rendered public buildings with flag poles and painted state-colour bands (green and white); Ntezi basket-weave motifs and Igbo carved doors on cultural buildings; church towers topped with crosses; blank roadside billboards.
